summary: Bosch uses a proprietary font ecosystem designed to maintain brand consistency worldwide. Bosch Sans is the general-purpose corporate typeface, complemented by specialized families for serif typography, global scripts, script/accent use, iconography, office environments, technical marking, and pixel displays.

primary_fonts.name: Bosch Sans
primary_fonts.role: Primary all-purpose corporate typeface for Western typesetting

primary_fonts.name: Bosch Serif
primary_fonts.role: Specialized serif font for representative long-form reading

primary_fonts.name: Bosch Sans Global
primary_fonts.role: Typeface for languages and scripts not fully covered by Latin-based Bosch Sans

primary_fonts.name: Bosch Script
primary_fonts.role: Expressive accent typeface based on Robert Bosch's handwriting
constraints: Should be used as an accentuation font only

primary_fonts.name: Bosch Icons
primary_fonts.role: Font containing Bosch icons, regularly updated

specialty_fonts.name: Bosch Sans Office
specialty_fonts.role: Office application font based on Arial
specialty_fonts.usage: Embedded in MS Office templates and presentations and installed as a system font on all workstations.
constraints: Only to be used in Microsoft Office applications

specialty_fonts.name: Bosch Sans Condensed
specialty_fonts.usage: For special applications with limited space, such as catalogs, instructions, packaging, and tables.

specialty_fonts.name: Bosch Sans Mono SemiCondensed
specialty_fonts.usage: Replaces Bosch Mono Engraving and Bosch Sans Engraving. Used for product markings and nameplates in engraving, print, and preview contexts.

specialty_fonts.name: Bosch Sans Mono SemiCondensed Lined (Trumpf)
specialty_fonts.usage: Optimized for technical applications and OCR. Provided in .lfn format for laser machines such as Trumpf.

specialty_fonts.name: Bosch Sans Pixel
specialty_fonts.usage: For pixel displays, mainly in product user interfaces.

typesetting.case: Use mixed case for headings and body text whenever possible
typesetting.hierarchy_rule: Heading size should be at least 1.5 times the size of body text
typesetting.tracking_rule: Headings and body text above 28 pt are slightly undercut; the larger the headline, the more the tracking is undercut

color_usage.emphasis_recommendation: Use colored type selectively. Bosch Sans Bold is recommended for colored markups.

first_level.special_case_color: Accent colors may be used in special cases

second_level.usage: Used for both lists and enumerations

accessibility.principle: Font size and contrast must ensure readability for all users
accessibility.contrast_reference: AAA for continuous text as captured in the source summary
accessibility.text_on_images: Ensure text clearly stands out from the background

cautions: Do not use deprecated additional Bosch Sans weights for new media unless already approved
Avoid full Bosch Sans Global as a webfont due to large file size; prefer localized subsets
Use Bosch Script only as an accent, not as a replacement for Bosch Sans
Use Bosch Sans Office only inside Microsoft Office applications
